Name: ofds_id
Title: Identifier
Description: A locally-unique identifier for this span.

Name: name
Title: Name
Description: A name for this span.

Name: phase
Title: Phase
Description: The phase to which this span belongs.

Name: status
Title: Status
Description: The status of the network infrastructure for this span, from the closed [spanStatus codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#spanstatus).

Name: readyForServiceDate
Title: Ready for service date
Description: The date this span was ready to carry traffic. For spans with multiple network providers, the earliest of the dates at which each provider's network was ready to carry traffic on this span.

Name: start
Title: Start
Description: The identifier of one of two nodes that this span connects. If the span is directed, it represents the starting point of the span.

Name: end
Title: End
Description: The identifier of one of two nodes that this span connects. If the span is directed, it represents the end point of the span.

Name: directed
Title: Directed
Description: Whether this span is directed. If the span is directed, the span begins at the node referenced in `.start` and ends at the node referenced in `.end`. Otherwise, the span connects the nodes referenced in `.start` and `.end` with no direction implied.

Name: transmissionMediumOwner
Title: Owner
Description: The organisation that owns the transmission media for this span, i.e. the fibre cables.

Name: supplier
Title: Supplier
Description: The organisation responsible for installing the cable for this span.

Name: supportingInfrastructure__type
Title: Supporting infrastructure Type
Description: The infrastructure that supports this span. The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [spanSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#spansupportinginfrastructure).

Name: supportingInfrastructure__description
Title: Supporting infrastructure Description
Description: The infrastructure that supports this span. A description of the supporting infrastructure for this span.

Name: supportingInfrastructure__owner
Title: Supporting infrastructure Owner
Description: The infrastructure that supports this span. The organisation that owns the supporting infrastructure.

Name: supportingInfrastructure__spareCapacity
Title: Supporting infrastructure Spare capacity
Description: The infrastructure that supports this span. Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional fibre cables.

Name: darkFibre
Title: Dark fibre availability
Description: Whether access to dark fibre is available on this span.

Name: fibreType
Title: Fibre type
Description: The type of fibre used in this span, from the closed [fibreType codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#fibretype). Further details of the span's fibre type can be provided in `.fibreTypeDetails`.

Name: fibreTypeDetails__fibreSubtype
Title: Fibre type details Subtype
Description: Further details about this span's fibre type. The sub-category of this span's fibre type. For example, G.652.B.

Name: fibreTypeDetails__description
Title: Fibre type details Description
Description: Further details about this span's fibre type. A description of this span's fibre type.

Name: fibreCount
Title: Fibre count
Description: The number of individual optical fibres in this span.

Name: fibreLength
Title: Fibre length
Description: The physical length in kilometres, of fibre optic cable used in this span.

Name: capacity
Title: Capacity
Description: The transmission rate, or throughput, of this span, expressed in Gbit/sec (Gbps). The equipped capacity is the total capacity of the circuits (e.g. E1, DS3, STM-1 etc.) which have been activated in the network transmission equipment of the span. For spans with multiple network providers, the sum of the capacity of each provider's network on this span. Further details of this span's capacity can be provided in `.capacityDetails`.

Name: capacityDetails__description
Title: Capacity details Description
Description: Further details about this span's capacity. A description of this span's capacity.
